scenes.headline:
What if missing a train
became a movie?
scenes.voiceText: What if missing the last train became two different movies? Let's build an app that makes the pitch.

scenes.headline:
First, tell AI
what to build.
scenes.voiceText: First, I asked AI to build a page with one situation box, a button, and two movie cards.

scenes.headline:
Then define
the story rules.
scenes.voiceText: Then I gave each style its own original title, genre, and story rules. No borrowed films or actors.

scenes.headline:
Now test
the button.
scenes.voiceText: I entered: I missed the last train. When I tap Make the movies, both cards appear.

scenes.headline:
Bollywood:
a musical mystery.
scenes.voiceText: In the Bollywood version, a missed train leads Mira into a rainy night of music and family secrets.

scenes.headline:
Hollywood:
a night thriller.
scenes.voiceText: In the Hollywood version, a phone on the platform warns that another train will disappear.

scenes.headline:
One idea.
Two movie worlds.
scenes.voiceText: Same everyday moment, two original pitches. What situation would you turn into a movie? The starter build is in the caption.
